components.name: Keyboard
components.description: Keyboard — native system keyboard for screen mockups (the OS draws it in code). Built from the real platform keyboards — iOS 27 (iPhone, 402 wide) and Material 3 Gboard (412 wide) — repainted with BEK colour tokens, so Light and Dark follow BEK Color modes. Platform (iOS · Android) × Type (Alphabet · Numeric: iOS Number Pad, Android Keypad). The nested native instance is exposed — switch its own T

10.3 Keyboard
Native iOS & Android keyboard layouts in BEK colours, for screen layouts. 4 variants · Platform × Type.
Overview
Place the keyboard in mockups wherever a field is focused, so layouts are checked with the real visible area. It is a mock — the real one comes from the OS.
